$comment: BEACON region registry (ADR-011, ADR-031; REGIONS_CONFIG). Canonical seed: MIGRATION_PLAN §5. Each region: enabled_adapters[] gate + per-source mode overrides. Adding a region = one entry here, zero code change (FR-10). Coverage resolution per SPEC §4.2 (OP4): out-of-region adapters return NOT_COVERED, labeled, never an error. Every id in enabled_adapters + source_mode_overrides is a REAL manifest id (config/adapters.json) — roadmap-only source names (config/planned-sources.md) are NOT listed here. enabled_adapters is ENFORCED since B1.3 (finding F-05): buildAdapterRegistry only instantiates the rows a region enables, so a source missing from this list is never consulted, never fetched and never labeled for that region. It is a PERMISSION list, not an obligation (usgs-water is permitted on us-ca but nothing consumes it yet); the lists below were reconciled with what the composition actually consults (open-meteo weather + the E11 camera directories + bluesky had landed in the manifest without ever being added here, so enforcing the allowlist would silently have dropped CA's weather layer and every camera pin). US-only rows are deliberately absent from `ro` — see its own $comment. B3.3 added three more zones (`es`, `gr`, `ph`) as CONFIG ENTRIES ONLY — no application code — which is the proof of the FR-10/FR-ZONE-3 claim; each is DEMO-GRADE, not us-ca parity, and states its own coverage gaps in its $comment.

regions.name: California (Flagship)
regions.$comment: enabled_adapters ORDER IS PRECEDENCE ORDER (B1.8): within a port/slot the first adapter that SERVES wins the slot, and every consulted adapter is cited in that order. firms before nifc = hotspots and perimeters both land (the fire badge cites the hotspot feed). open-meteo before nws = Open-Meteo is CA's primary weather, NWS its fallback rung — LOAD-BEARING, because the manifest lists nws first, so taking precedence from the manifest instead of from here would silently switch CA's weather source. nwps before usgs-water = NWPS primary gauge, USGS the fallback rung. census before worldpop = the US-specific 'Census preferred' rule that used to be hardcoded in live-seed.ts, now region config (ADR-012). Camera directories in E11 priority order: caltrans-cctv > alertwildfire > dot511 > windy-webcams. S3: airnow before openaq for the NEW airQuality slot (SitRep threshold fact only — no existing slot's precedence touched): the US EPA's own published AQI outranks the aggregator; openaq is the global fallback rung. S3 enablement (2026-08-08, D-38 executed per-slot): metno appended as the LAST weather rung (global met.no fallback behind open-meteo/nws — winner unchanged); mastodon/openfema/caphub/lanceflood appended to the NewsIntel batch (fusion is additive: more corroboration outlets, no displaced slot); eonet/cemsrm appended as EVENT hazard feeds (cited, never drawn — HAZARD_FOOTPRINT_SOURCES); nri appended as the LAST population rung (FEMA NRI county table carries the 2020 Decennial POPULATION column verbatim; census→worldpop→nri, and the S3 populationGrounding fix makes whichever serves CITE itself). hifld is deliberately NOT enabled: its static-2019 node set displaces the seeded infrastructure slice and silently breaks the derived 'ASSUMED offline' outage marking (the reverted S2 trial, D-38) — enabling it needs a merge-not-replace slot design.

regions.name: Romania (EU Flood)
regions.$comment: enabled_adapters ORDER IS PRECEDENCE ORDER (B1.8): glofas ahead of the (unlisted, US-only) gauges makes GloFAS RO's flood primary; effis before gdacs means the EU/global fire PERIMETER source fills the hazard footprint slot while GDACS stays an event feed (cited, never drawn as a footprint); cnadnr-ro before windy-webcams is the RO camera priority. CACHED portability demo (D-25). Demo fixture: Copernicus EMSR758 (Galați/Vaslui floods, Sep 2024). US-only adapters (nwps/usgs-water/nfhl/eagle-i/census/nifc) and the US camera directories (caltrans-cctv/alertwildfire/dot511) are NOT enabled → the allowlist keeps them out of RO's registry entirely, and their coverage gate would return NOT_COVERED anyway (SPEC §4.2, OP4): two independent reasons the same wrong data can never reach RO. RO's own camera sources are cnadnr-ro (RO official highway cams) + windy-webcams (GLOBAL). RO outage exposure is derived hazard∩infra only (no RO-specific outage feed wired), labeled. Agency-RSS uses AGENCYRSS_FEEDS_RO (Digi24/ProTV/HotNews/Mediafax, verified 2026-07-02). S3: sensorcommunity before openaq for the NEW airQuality slot (SitRep threshold fact only) — the citizen PM network is dense in RO (ODbL, keyless LIVE) and the US-only airnow is NOT enabled here. S3 enablement (2026-08-08, D-38 executed per-slot): metno + anm appended as weather fallback rungs (open-meteo stays the winner; anm is RO's own agency, CACHED because its host refused our TLS handshake); mastodon/caphub/lanceflood appended to the NewsIntel batch; eonet/cemsrm appended as EVENT hazard feeds (cemsrm's EMSR758 activation is this zone's own demo fixture); hdxpop appended as the LAST population rung behind worldpop (HDX CKAN, per-dataset licences carried in provenance).

regions.name: Spain (EU Wildfire, demo-grade)
regions.$comment: enabled_adapters ORDER IS PRECEDENCE ORDER (B1.8). HAZARD FOOTPRINTS FIRST: firms before effis = FIRMS hotspots AND EFFIS perimeters both land, and the fire layer's freshness badge cites the near-real-time hotspot feed (the us-ca precedent); gdacs comes after both because it is an EVENT feed — consulted and cited, never drawn as a footprint (live-seed HAZARD_FOOTPRINT_SOURCES). open-meteo is ES's ONLY permitted weather source (nws is US-only and NOT enabled) and glofas its only flood gauge (nwps/usgs-water are US-only), so those two slots have one rung each — no silent second choice. worldpop is the only population source (census is US-only), so ES has no census-before-worldpop decision to make. meteoalarm-es LEADS the NewsIntel slot so the OFFICIAL national warning source (MeteoAlarm relays AEMET's CAP warnings) is consulted and cited ahead of gdelt/reliefweb/agency-rss and the MOCK bluesky rung. windy-webcams is ES's only camera directory. NO US-only rows are enabled (nwps/nfhl/eagle-i/census/nifc/caltrans-cctv/dot511/alertwildfire): they would return NOT_COVERED anyway, and listing them would inflate the zone's source list — the dishonesty class F-63 corrected once already. Modes are INHERITED from the manifest (no per-zone override): meteoalarm-es/effis/glofas stay CACHED and are labelled CACHED, never LIVE. HONEST LIMITATIONS (this zone is DEMO-GRADE, not us-ca parity): (1) there is NO AEMET-direct adapter and NO DGT traffic-camera adapter in this build — the B3.3 backlog line named both; ES ships on MeteoAlarm's relay of AEMET warnings plus the global stack, which is thinner than the flagship. (2) The bbox is MAINLAND SPAIN + THE BALEARIC ISLANDS only — the Canary Islands, Ceuta and Melilla are deliberately OUTSIDE it: a bbox reaching the Canaries would span ~2000 km of open Atlantic and imply operational coverage BEACON does not have. MeteoAlarm warnings for those territories are therefore out of extent. (3) agency-rss has no ES feed list (only AGENCYRSS_FEEDS_RO exists), so ES receives the worldwide feed set, not Spanish media. BBOX SOURCE: the four extreme points of peninsular Spain + Balearics — Punta de Estaca de Bares 43°47'N, Punta de Tarifa 36°00'N, Cabo Touriñán 9°18'W, La Mola/Menorca 4°19'E — each rounded OUTWARD so no extreme is clipped; contained by the OSM/Nominatim ES boundary bbox (-18.394,27.434,4.592,43.993, which includes the Canaries) and consistent with EPSG:4258's declared scope 'Spain - mainland and Balearic islands'. S3: sensorcommunity before openaq for the NEW airQuality slot (SitRep threshold fact only) — both GLOBAL-coverage; the US-only airnow is NOT enabled. S3 enablement (2026-08-08): metno appended as the weather fallback rung; mastodon/caphub/lanceflood appended to the NewsIntel batch; eonet/cemsrm appended as EVENT hazard feeds (cited, never drawn).

regions.name: Greece (EU Wildfire, demo-grade)
regions.$comment: enabled_adapters ORDER IS PRECEDENCE ORDER (B1.8). Same shape as `es` and for the same reasons — Greece's flagship hazard is summer wildfire, so the FOOTPRINT sources lead: firms (hotspots, near-real-time, badges the fire layer) before effis (official EU perimeters), with gdacs last of the three because it is an EVENT feed that is cited but never drawn. open-meteo is the only permitted weather source and glofas the only flood gauge (the NWPS/USGS rungs are US-only and NOT enabled); worldpop is the only population source. meteoalarm-gr LEADS the NewsIntel slot: EMY/HNMS's official warnings reach BEACON through MeteoAlarm, so the national authority is cited ahead of gdelt/reliefweb/agency-rss/bluesky. windy-webcams is GR's only camera directory — there is no Greek equivalent of cnadnr-ro in this build. NO US-only rows are enabled (F-63). Modes INHERITED from the manifest: meteoalarm-gr/effis/glofas are CACHED and labelled CACHED. HONEST LIMITATIONS (DEMO-GRADE, not us-ca parity): no national gauge network, no national camera directory, no Greek agency-rss feed list (GR gets the worldwide AGENCYRSS_FEEDS set), and the meteoalarm-gr fixture is hand-authored recorded-style (feed live-verified 2026-07-18, body not recorded — see B3.1). BBOX SOURCE: the four extreme points of the Hellenic Republic — Ormenio/Trigono border 41°44'52"N, Cape Trypiti on Gavdos 34°48'03"N (also continental Europe's southernmost point), Xilosermi on Othonoi 19°22'26"E, and the islet of Strongyli in the Megisti/Kastellorizo group 29°38'43"E — each rounded OUTWARD so no inhabited island is clipped; contained by the OSM/Nominatim GR boundary bbox (19.113,34.719,29.684,41.749). S3: sensorcommunity before openaq for the NEW airQuality slot (SitRep threshold fact only) — both GLOBAL-coverage; the US-only airnow is NOT enabled. S3 enablement (2026-08-08): metno appended as the weather fallback rung; mastodon/caphub/lanceflood appended to the NewsIntel batch; eonet/cemsrm appended as EVENT hazard feeds (cited, never drawn).

regions.name: Philippines (Typhoon/Flood, demo-grade)
regions.$comment: enabled_adapters ORDER IS PRECEDENCE ORDER (B1.8). PH's hazard story is TYPHOON + FLOOD, not fire, so the order states that: gdacs first as the global storm/flood EVENT feed (cited on the SitRep path, never drawn as a footprint — the same advisory-vs-footprint rule as F-48), then glofas, which is PH's ONLY flood gauge — F-51 recorded that no PH gauge network was verified, so PH gauges fall to global GloFAS and nothing pretends otherwise. open-meteo is the only weather source, osm-overpass the only lifeline source, worldpop the only population source, opencellid the only telecom source. wmo-swic LEADS the NewsIntel slot because PAGASA is the Philippines' registered WMO-SWIC alerting authority (`ph-pagasa-en`, CAP v1.2, keyless, explicitly CC BY 4.0) — the national alert source outranks gdelt/reliefweb/agency-rss and the MOCK bluesky rung. windy-webcams is the only camera directory (F-51: no PH camera source was verified). firms IS enabled — SUPERSEDING this file's earlier exclusion of it (2026-08-08, entrant decision 19 in docs/LIVE_DEMO_DELIVERY_PLAN.md §0). The original reasoning stands on its own terms and is preserved here rather than deleted: PH's hazard story is typhoon+flood, and F-63 objected that a second fire feed nothing consumes inflates the zone's source list. What changed is the requirement, not the analysis — EVERY zone must now carry at least one ALWAYS-LIVE wildfire source and one always-live flood source, so that no region's live coverage depends on whichever regional feed happens to be reachable. firms (global, keyed, LIVE) and gdacs (global, keyless) are that pair. effis stays OUT: it is an EU product with no Philippine coverage, so enabling it would add a source that cannot answer for this bbox — which is the F-63 objection in its still-valid form. NO US-only rows are enabled. Modes INHERITED from the manifest — wmo-swic/glofas stay CACHED and are labelled CACHED, never LIVE. HONEST LIMITATIONS (DEMO-GRADE): PAGASA's `acp` tropical-cyclone CAP area is its whole Area of Responsibility, not a storm footprint (F-48) — the wmo-swic adapter never constructs a HazardGeometry at all, so it CANNOT reach the hazard layer or exposure; storm footprints stay with gdacs. No PH gauges, no PH cameras, no PH agency-rss feed list. BBOX SOURCE: the extreme points of the UNDISPUTED main archipelago — Mavulis (Y'Ami) Island, Batanes 21°07'18"N; Frances Reef, Sitangkai, Tawi-Tawi 4°24'54"N; Balabac Great Reef 116°53'17"E; Pusan Point, Caraga, Davao Oriental 126°36'18"E — each rounded OUTWARD. This CORRECTS the spike's suggested `[116.93, 4.59, 126.60, 21.12]`, which F-51 flagged as not geodetically verified and which in fact clipped ALL FOUR extremes (Balabac Great Reef, Saluag Island, Pusan Point and Mavulis all fell outside it). The Kalayaan Island Group (Pag-asa 114°17'E), which OSM's PH relation includes as a claim, is deliberately OUTSIDE this extent: BEACON draws an operating envelope, not a territorial position. Contained by EPSG:4683 (PRS92) 'Philippines - onshore and offshore' 116.04,3.0,129.95,22.18. S3: openaq is PH's ONLY airQuality rung (GLOBAL aggregator; SitRep threshold fact only) — sensorcommunity's density is European and airnow is North-America-only, so neither is listed (F-63: an enabled row that cannot answer inflates the source list; openaq alone is the honest entry). S3 enablement (2026-08-08): metno appended as the weather fallback rung; mastodon/caphub/lanceflood appended to the NewsIntel batch (lanceflood = NRT GRANULE AVAILABILITY, not observed flood extent — the honesty caveat travels with the id); eonet/cemsrm appended as EVENT hazard feeds (cited, never drawn).
